reusable_abi_lessons: Treat the 32-bit VM program cursor at 0x80077858 as distinct from the signed-halfword text-token cursor in 0x801C77E8.
Reload globals after callbacks where original MIPS does so; host references that cache a resource/window/cursor across callbacks are not equivalent.
Preserve branch-likely delay-slot semantics and original stack-frame/spill layouts; a size-equal symbol is not instruction exact.
Keep resource ID, loaded resource base, relocation delta, and relocated program address as distinct values.
Validate every changed candidate in the complete 10,112-byte script_vm.c unit; target-local equality can still move a forward-call relocation or sibling symbol.
Main-segment VMA-to-ROM mapping is VMA minus 0x7FFFF400; overlay functions require their own file/section mapping and cannot enter this list by address similarity.
